title: Quietly Smoky Malaysian Cobnuts Satay
description: A smoky and crispy Malaysian dish featuring cobnuts, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this ovo-vegetarian friendly satay is made with binchotan-charcoal for a unique flavor.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan-charcoal grill to a medium heat.
In a bowl, mix together the coconut milk, vegetable oil, binchotan charcoal powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the chopped cobnuts to the bowl and stir until they are well coated with the mixture.
Thread the cobnuts onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking, then grill the satay for 5 minutes on each side.
In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs and set aside.
Once the satay is cooked, brush them with the whisked eggs and grill for an additional minute.
Serve the satay hot with a side of lemongrass and garlic.
Garnish with additional smoked paprika if desired.
